description: This source file defines the ChatMarkdownPreprocessor enum, which provides static methods for parsing and cleaning up Markdown input, especially from chat messages. It includes functions to strip out metadata, headers, timestamps, and image patterns, and encapsulates logic for handling untrusted context blocks and embedded images.

classes.name: InlineImage
classes.description: A struct representing an inline image extracted from Markdown, with a label and optional image data.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: A struct holding the cleaned Markdown string and associated images after preprocessing.

methods.name: preprocess
methods.description: Main function to clean and process raw Markdown input, removing envelope info, message ID hints, context blocks, timestamps, and extracting embedded images.

methods.name: inlineImage
methods.description: Creates an InlineImage if the source string contains a valid base64-encoded data URI for an inline image.

methods.name: fallbackImageLabel
methods.description: Provides a fallback label for images that cannot be decoded.

methods.name: stripEnvelope
methods.description: Removes envelope headers from the raw input if they match expected patterns.

methods.name: looksLikeEnvelopeHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header string resembles a known envelope header or channel.

methods.name: stripMessageIdHints
methods.description: Removes message ID hint lines from the raw input.

methods.name: stripInboundContextBlocks
methods.description: Removes inbound context blocks and metadata, handling fenced JSON segments.

methods.name: shouldStripTrailingUntrustedContext
methods.description: Determines if a trailing untrusted context should be stripped based on specific regex pattern matching.

methods.name: stripPrefixedTimestamps
methods.description: Removes timestamp prefixes from lines based on regex matching.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes line endings and trims excessive newlines in the raw text.
